proposals.defect: Permanent (non-retryable) provider failures get an extra 'last chance' provider call after the retry loop, so they produce two provider interactions instead of exactly one.

Provider errors are converted to boundary errors inside the retry attempt, so the retry machinery sees a wrapped, non-transient error and never retries retryable status/transport failures on the same route.
